flavor: A rhythmic, heavy thudding echoes through the corridor. A line of pale, stiff-limbed 僵尸 marches forward, their movements jerky and unnatural. Instead of reaching for weapons, they tilt their heads forward, their foreheads gleaming with a dull, metallic sheen as they prepare to charge with a devastating 铁头功 strike.
name: The Iron-Skull Vanguard
reason: The party must decide whether to attempt to disrupt the momentum of the charging undead or brace for the impact of their kinetic force.
